name: Madboks food distribution - Kalpelvej 44
description:
Hey food savers! Join us at our weekly food distribution in Nørrebro at Kapelvej 44. Our events are open to everyone, no matter the financial status or conditions.
To BOOK A SPOT, please follow this link: https://forms.gle/143s2dJNnbe5aM356
BOOK ONLY if you will be able to come, so the food won’t go to waste. In order to save the waste, we will keep your booking for 15 minutes, after that the food will be given to other people. If you know you would be late for picking up your box, please contact us on Facebook in advance so we hold on to your box.
Everyone can donate what they can afford for the food boxes, however, the recommended donation is 25 DKK, so that we can cover the costs of the event.
Please bring 2 bags to carry the food in. Pro tip! Bring a separate bag for bread and pastry, and we also recommend bringing some food containers/Tupperware, to be able to transport small/easily reusable items safely.
Please also consider becoming a volunteer ❤ It takes a small village to make these food distributions happen weekly! To register as a volunteer please sign up here: https://myshopify.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe

name: Madboks food distribution 29/12 - Sundholmsvej 28a
description:
Every Sunday, Madboks volunteers get together to save food  from going to waste and raise awareness of this massive issue in our society. You can find us at Sundholmsvej 28a and you can join us to collect some food for yourself and/or become a volunteer!

Book a box of food ONLY if you will be able to come, so the food won’t go to waste. In order to save the waste, we will keep your booking for 10-15 minutes, after that the food will be given to someone else. If you know you will be late for picking up your box, please contact us in advance. Our main goal is to prevent food from going to waste.

To BOOK A BOX, please follow this link: 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1IZJ0VNiryKy6YUm3gHMs8FRQszRYX4KQTff9B5Lc7hc/edit

Our food boxes are given out on a donation basis - Everyone can donate what they can afford for the food boxes, however, the minimum recommended donation is 25 DKK, so that we can cover the costs of each food distribution event.

Please bring a bag to carry the food in. 
Pro tip! Bring a separate bag for bread and pastry, and we also recommend bringing some food containers/Tupperware, to be able to transport small/easily bruisable items safely.

If you want to register as a volunteer, please sign up here: 
https://myshopify.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=21366f082c5af1add473caecc&id=35fa4efaa0&fbclid=IwAR3s9b--DMro1EeYEtST0XlUMclBywow1p1EUv__o92Coi1M1WcumRmlJLY

name: Decembristerne Performancedag og Januar Udsalg
description:
One Thing Leads to Another er en hel dag med performances arrangeret af kunstner og Decembrist Heine Klausen. Den finder sted på sidste dag af Decembristernes udstilling Extralys og kommer til at foregå i Den Fries sale. De følgende fem kunstnere præsenterer værker: Ditte Krøyer, Favn Vium, Heine Klausen, Emil Keller Skouvsen, Rosa Halfdan Quistorff. 
Det er gratis at deltage i arrangementet, når billet til udstillingen er betalt.

Program

14:30 – Rosa Halfdan Quistorff
15:00 – Emil Keller Skouvsen
15:30 – Favn Vium
16:00 – Ditte Krøyer

Samme dag holder Decembristerne Januar Udsalg i Den Fries Café Pegasus, hvor du vil kunne købe billige værker, multiples og grafik m.v. af sammenslutningens medlemmer.

name: New Jungle Orchestra feat Ronja Rose Andersson. Nytårskoncert!
description:
Pierre Dørge & New Jungle Orchestra feat Ronja Rose Andersson  
NYTÅRSKONCERT 30.12. 25 i Koncertkirken

New Jungle Orchestra inviterer i år den unge talentfulde sanger, saxofonist og komponist Ronja Rose Andersson med til vores traditionsrige Nytårskoncert.

Ronja Rose Andersson  er det nye fremadstormende unge talent på den danske og svenske vokal-scene, og hun har det sidste års tid markeret sig stærkt som sanger, saxofonist, komponist og arrangør. Ronja er allerede en del af et væld af forskellige projekter som blandt andet Komorebi og den prisvindende gruppe MUSVIT. Sidstnævnte kvartet udgav deres debut EP af samme navn i februar 2025. Som 22-årig har hun allerede fået sit navn plantet solidt på det danske jazzlandkort, senest med nomineringen som Årets Musiker til DMA Jazz 2025 og med et pakket program på sommerens Copenhagen Jazz Festival. 

Pierre Dørge & New Jungle Orchestra har igennem årene har haft mange fantastiske  gæste-solister med på vores årlige Nytårskoncert,  lige fra John Tchicai, Povl Dissing, Gitte Hænning, Palle Mikkelborg til Josefine Cronholm, Bent Clausen, Rasmus Lyberth, Sinne Eg, Lelo Nika, Aviaja Lumholt, Søren Rislund, Christina von Bülow og Mathilde Bondo.
New Jungle Orchestra er i topform efter 10 vilde dage med koncerter i Jylland og på Sjælland og spændende koncerter med Figura Ensemble og det slovakiske Veni Ensemble.
Vi er meget betagede af Ronja Rose Anderssons musiceren og glæder os til at spille med hende!

Line up:
Gæste-solist: Ronja Rose Andersson, vokal, saxofon
Pierre Dørge            dirigent og guitar
Gunnar Halle           trompet
Jakob Mygind          saxer
Anders Banke          klarinetter og saxer
Kenneth Agerholm   trombone
Irene Becker             piano
Thommy Andersson bas 
Ayi Solomon             perkussion
Martin Andersen       trommer
 
Dørene åbnes 19:30     Koncerten er støttet af Statens Kunstfond

name: Spleen United - 2. Ekstrakoncert – A Celebration at VEGA - VEGA
description:
Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA
____________________________________________________________

Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 395 kr. inkl. gebyr. 
_____________________________________________________________

Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA bliver en totaloplevelse, hvor publikum får alt: musikken, historien, rummet og festen. Tre aftener dedikeret til et album, der stadig vibrerer og et band, der stadig flytter grænser.

 "Da VEGA spurgte, om vi havde lyst til at opskalere koncerterne til en full-blown fejring af Godspeed, var der ingen tvivl herfra", forklarer Bjarke Niemann.

Med tre aftener i træk forvandles VEGA til et levende univers under titlen Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA. Publikum kan se frem til mere end koncerter. Det bliver tre dage med lys, lyd, installationer og fest, hvor hele huset summer af Spleen Uniteds energi. 

Inden lyset dæmpes og koncerten går i gang i Store VEGA, kan gæsterne træde ind i en særlig installation i VEGA LAB. Oplevelsen bliver både sanselig, interaktiv og oplagt til deling. 

Udstillingen i VEGA LAB fortsætter fejringen med billeder, grafik og originale genstande fra bandets tidlige år, blandt andet den ikoniske discokugle fra Godspeed-coveret.

I Ideal Bar kan man inden koncerterne genopleve Spleen Uniteds legendariske MTV-optræden fra 2006. 

Når koncerterne runder af, er festen langt fra forbi. Spleen United vender tilbage i Lille VEGA, når salen forvandles til en elektronisk oase med et eksklusivt set; en energifyldt rejse inspireret af bandets lydunivers, hvor beats, bas og nostalgi mødes i et nyt efterspil.

name: PUUT-library celebration of  mini-residency with book presentation & more
description:
Greetings and welcome!
The festivities continue at Red Door... with a celebration of the mini-residency that Karl Larsson and the PUUT library have been doing in our gallery during December.

On December 29 at Red Door, Møllegade 23a, at 2200 Copenhagen, between 4 and 8 pm there will be a gathering, which will include multilingual live readings and live music. Amongst other things, you can also:

*Get a book from Red Door's excellent selection of books, t-shirts and magazines to support our current campain to keep Red Door open, or give your support via gofundme:
https://www.gofundme.com/f/keep-red-door-open

*Jakob Sahlström and Ulrika Pihlström will congregate a minor liturgy called “A Complete Syllabary For A Squalling Library” With haphazardly serendipitous adlib and bindings by Karl Larsson for a eventual inclusion into PUUT.

*Kristian Sverdrup will read from the newly made PUUT 145 – In this village bears walk the streets and play balalaikas.

*Nicklas Wallén & Karl Larsson will present The Red Line, a work in progress that will be published at the PUUT library.

Also on stage: 
Hans Kjellsson, Micke Fasth, Emil Ahlbertz, Dag Persson

*The PUUT library is open for you to return/loan, or become a member to make your first loan. Come and get your very own PUUT library card!

As always, this is a free event, and all are welcome.
